req.title: Delete only by author
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden when a user attempts to delete a post they did not author.

doc.reasoning: Two violations were reported: test[4] has kind=negative but heuristic=STC, and test[5] has kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule requires that negative tests do not use STC or EP heuristics — those are reserved for positive/structural tests. Fix: change test[4] (unauthenticated delete) heuristic from STC to NEG (it is a negative/error-pathway test probing the unauthenticated state), and change test[5] (second non-author user) heuristic from EP to NEG (it is a negative test confirming 403 for a different non-author). All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_author_can_delete_own_post
preconditions: User Rahul (id=1) is the author of post id=2
trace: R-FLASKR-020: author is permitted — positive equivalence partition
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r.status_code == 302
r = client.post('/2/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_adjacent_user_id_non_author_delete_returns_403

Anjali (id=2) has id = author_id - 1; Diya (id=4) has id = author_id + 1

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()
# author_id - 1: Anjali id=2, post 17 author is Ishaan id=3
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Anjali', 'password': 'cloud'})
assert r.status_code == 302
r = client.post('/17/delete')
assert r.status_code == 403
client.get('/auth/logout')
# author_id + 1: Diya id=4
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Diya', 'password': 'cloud'})
assert r.status_code == 302
r = client.post('/17/delete')
assert r.status_code == 403
